about.title: About me
about.lead: Computer Engineer with 4+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer, fluent in Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, PHP, React, and Angular.
about.body: I've actively participated in the complete software lifecycle: from requirements gathering and user story generation to initial architecture, Full-Stack development, and production deployment. Additionally, I've led quality strategies ensuring system stability through advanced automation with Playwright and Cypress.
about.ai: I use AI at every layer of the stack. Orchestrators like Gentle-AI, Kimi K2 and DeepSeek handle phase-based project planning and requirements structuring; Open Code + MiniMax validates user stories against implemented code (reducing defects before production); and Gemini and Claude (via Antigravity) accelerate code writing and auto-generate Playwright E2E suites in CI/CD under Scrum. I also build retrieval-augmented generation systems end-to-end — vectorized knowledge bases with Pinecone, OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for embeddings, GPT-4o-mini for answer synthesis with citation-grounded outputs, PDF/TXT ingestion with overlap chunking, and similarity search with configurable score thresholds; all wired through a hexagonal architecture (Ports & Adapters) so the LLM provider and vector store are swappable. The rag-tech project is the production embodiment of this stack: a FastAPI service that ingests documents, indexes them in Pinecone, retrieves the most relevant chunks per query, and returns answers with their source citations.

resumeTailor.title: Resume Tailor AI v2.5
resumeTailor.description: Full-Stack AI platform that audits and tailors CVs to job descriptions via a chain of three LLM providers (OpenAI-compatible primary → Gemini cascade fallback). Spring Boot 3.4 + Angular 21 + PostgreSQL 15 + Docker.
